name: all fours squad stretch
interpretation: Anatomical LEFT all-fours quadriceps stretch. The left hand lifts, approaches with a forearm-aligned wrist, closes around the heel/ankle collar before the pull, and remains fixed in the foot frame through pull, hold and unloading. The fingers open before the arm retracts. The right palm, knee and resting foot support the body. Mirror the complete action and highlights for the other side. This five-second demonstration is separate from the source 20–30 second workout hold.

source_cue_disagreement.description: Pull one foot toward the glutes from all fours.

source.description: On all fours you pull one foot toward your glutes to stretch the front of the thigh. It eases tight quads.
instructions: Start on all fours with your hands directly under your shoulders and your knees directly under your hips.
Extend one leg straight back, keeping your knee bent and your foot flexed.
Slowly lower your hips towards the ground, feeling a stretch in your quads.
Switch legs and repeat the stretch on the other side.
